name: investment_fibo
description: Investment relationship ontology — investor/manager relationships, subscription agreements, fund commitments, and commercial terms. Updated to support direct concrete entity-to-entity relations and companion value entities for attributes.

entity_types.guidance: The overall investing relationship between an investor and an investment manager — the top-level record that ties together the parties, their governing agreement, and their subscriptions.
A party that commits capital — an institution, fund-of-funds, pension scheme, family office, or individual subscribing to a fund.
The firm that manages the fund and its investment programme (general partner, asset manager, adviser).
The contract governing the investment relationship — limited partnership agreement, investment management agreement, subscription agreement, or similar named document.
A specific act of subscribing into a fund under the relationship — the instrument recording that an investor bought in.
The named investment vehicle being invested into (a fund, sub-fund, feeder, or share class named as such).
The committed capital undertaking attached to a subscription or investor obligation.
The commercial terms of an agreement — the negotiated economics clause covering fees, hurdles, carry, and discounts.
A named fee schedule, fee table, or fee appendix that defines how fees are calculated.
A document amending an existing agreement — amendment, restatement, addendum, or variation deed.
A side letter supplementing an agreement with investor-specific terms (MFN, fee rebates, reporting, or capacity rights).
The formally incorporated legal person behind a party — the registered company, partnership, or trust.
A currency and numeric value representation, e.g., $5,000,000 or USD 10M.
An effective date, execution date, or termination date stated in text.
A percentage rate such as management fee rate, performance fee rate, or hurdle rate.
A formal identifier such as an LEI code, registration number, or contract identification code.

relations.guidance: An investment relationship has an investor as one of its parties.
An investment relationship has an investment manager as its other party.
An investment relationship is governed by an agreement.
An investment relationship or investor executes a subscription.
A party, manager, or legal entity that enters into or signs an agreement, side letter, or amendment.
An investment manager manages, operates, or sponsors a fund.
A subscription or investor invests directly into a named fund.
A subscription, investor, or relationship carries a capital commitment obligation.
An agreement, side letter, or amendment sets out commercial terms.
Commercial terms or agreements are defined by a fee schedule.
An agreement is amended by an amendment document.
An agreement is supplemented by a side letter.
An investor, manager, or fund is backed by a formally incorporated legal entity.
A commitment or commercial term has a specific monetary value amount.
A commercial term or fee schedule defines a fee percentage rate.
The effective or execution date of a document or subscription.
An entity or agreement has an official registration number, LEI, or reference identifier.
